source_crops.item: Figure 23 C1, writing: raw and adjusted shares

notes: Rates are survey weighted; N is unweighted respondent-wave or performed-activity observations.
Small cells (20–49 observations) are shaded and marked *. Their differences should not be interpreted as precise rankings.
Below-20 rates remain suppressed, never replaced by zero; no survey-design confidence intervals are invented.
Tasks are pooled across all reporting occupations, not restricted to the named student career areas.
Broad SOC groups are not interchangeable with detailed O*NET occupations in the first lecture.
No exposure/adoption merge or occupation weighting using unweighted counts is performed.
Rapid Adoption results verified against the published 2026 PDF. Table 1 entries, not inconsistent adjacent prose, determine regression coefficients and fit; Figure 9(d) reports 0.01.
Chat topic chart uses printed unadjusted estimates; source panel with adjusted estimates and confidence intervals is retained in the appendix.
